params.title: Wage tax payments
params.description: Each confirmed wage tax return, handed to bookkeeping as a draft payment to the Belastingdienst.

params.title: Wage tax payment
params.note: payroll-wage-tax-remittance-shillinq: a WageTaxRemittance is humaniq's log of one hand-off of a confirmed return into shillinq's APTransaction register, never the payable itself. Same shape as PayrollPaymentBatchDetail. Copy says ready in bookkeeping, never paid: money moves only after shillinq issues and pays it. No lifecycle actions: WageTaxRemittanceService writes every status.
